subject: english-language
title: Where Media Lives
welcome_lead: TV, print, online, radio — each shapes its message.
meta_desc: KS3 English Language adventure on types of media.
final_note: You can now name and compare the main media types.

walkthroughs.body_html: The big four media: print, TV, radio, online. Each delivers messages differently — print is permanent, online is fast.
Every media text targets an audience. A cereal advert on Saturday morning TV targets children; a wealth podcast targets adults.
'Media' is the type (online); 'platform' is the specific place (TikTok, Instagram). Each platform has its own rules.
